quality_guards: Fire and rescue legislation defines authority functions but does not prove local real-time resource availability.
Accredited fire statistics are retrospective recorded activity rather than a live incident feed.
The Building Safety Regulator strategic plan is a national roadmap and not an individual-building approval.
NHS EPRR organisational ratings rely on self-assessment and subsequent assurance review.
EPRR compliance does not prove real-time clinical or operational capacity during a specific incident.
DSEAR controls require hazardous-area, process and equipment-specific competent application.
Reservoir thresholds and programme counts do not establish failure probability for a specific structure.
Civil-contingency duties and national risk products require current local plans, capabilities and incident adaptation.
Official-source context is not converted into exact parcel-level probability.
Live 130-candidate/16-endpoint parity, browser DOM/console acceptance and publisher remote readback remain required.
No second runner was started; the stale single-runner recovery blocker remains OPEN.
